sentences: Read the plan, before it is paid for.
On Nightshift, a video starts with a topic, and a price you can see.

items.label: 3  STORYBOARD READY
items.sub: The run stops and waits for you

sentences: Switch on storyboard review for a channel.
The run writes the script and the scene plan.
Then it stops at storyboard ready, and waits for you.
Nothing is rendered, and no render is charged, until you approve.
Want changes? Edit a scene's narration.
Delete one, or add one. Save, and the price updates.

items.title: Price changed?
items.sub: You are asked again before it starts

sentences: Happy with it? Approve and render, at the price on the button.
Not happy? Discard it. Saying no costs nothing.
And if the price changes in between, you are asked again.
